.peer-ai/work/SB-1.json.title: Add an optional tip
.peer-ai/work/SB-1.json.goal: A bill can be split with an optional tip, given as a whole percentage, and the shares still add up to the cent.
acceptance: Given a bill of 1000 cents, 3 people and a 10% tip, when it's split, then the shares add up to 1100 cents.
Given a tip that isn't a whole cent, when it's split, then the tip is rounded half up to the nearest cent before splitting.
Given no tip, or a tip of 0%, when a bill is split, then the shares are exactly what they are today.
Given a tip below 0% or above 100%, or not a whole number, when a bill is split, then it's refused with a clear message.
.peer-ai/work/SB-1.json.next: Write the tests from the acceptance criteria.

points.point: SB-1 reached ship, with a passing verify recorded.
The change adds a test for each of SB-1's four acceptance criteria.
The tip is rounded half up to a whole cent before splitting, and the shares add up to the bill plus the tip.
Splitting with no tip works exactly as before, and the existing tests are unchanged.
A tip below 0%, above 100% or not a whole number is refused with a clear message.
A code review is recorded on SB-1.
Stays within SB-1: nothing for uneven splits or anything else.
